Update 1.0 (Released)
- FS 4 Flight Tracker Released ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.90
- Change code comment markers from Thai to English. - Add Switch Speed Button in Volanta Style.
I didn't have the chance to develop the vertical version; it was too complex. I decided to release update 0.90 instead.
However, the launch is just around the corner: FS 4 Flight Tracker version 1.0 will be available for download on September 14, 2026. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.80
- Remove Roll - Remove Pitch - Update Custom HUD Adjust the size font appropriately.
For version 0.90, I will receive the official release date announcement, and the 0.90 update will support the vertical aspect ratio for TikTok live streams. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.70
- Add Enable Taskbar - Add Enable TransparencyKey - Add Enable TopMost - Add Status Version - Add Bad Language - Add Throttle Support Aircraft Airbus and Boeing ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.61
- Fix Throttle Progress ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.60
- Add Throttle Status - Update Main Menu - Remove Aircraft Name and Livery Name (There are a lot of bugs that cannot be fixed.) - Update Aircraft Name and Livery Name to Select yourself ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.50
- Update status run game - Update and fix arrival airport ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.40
- Custom Taskbar - Add Button Restart - Update Switch for Aircraft Name and Livery - Additional Update Main Menu ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.30
- Add Next HUD - Additional Custom HUD Updates. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.292
- Add Custom HUD - Upgrade Visual Studio 2019 Community to Visual Studio 2022 Community ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.291
- Fix Speed ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.29
- Add Switch Color Background - Add Progress 0 to 100 for Departure to Arrival - Add Remaining Distance for Departure to Arrival
- Fix Arrival Position
Note: Version 0.30 is nearing release, and the changelog will be compiled in a public post. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.28
- Add Player Position - Add Departure Position - Add Arrival Position ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.27
- Add Timer UTC ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.26
- Add Livery Airbus A321 / A321 XLR - Add more aircraft. Boeing 737 / 747 / 777 / 787 and Concorde ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.25
- Add Livery Name for Aircraft - Successfully completed for A319, A320, and A320 neo. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.24
- Add Name Aircraft (Work in Progress) ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.23
- Work in Progress Volanta - Add Text Arrival ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.12
- Update the Departure Text status by performing the first memory read. ❤️❤️❤️ ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.2
- Add Name Aircraft (Work in progress) - Add Roll Status Text - Add Support main.mcf ----------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 0.1
- I'm creating my first project. - Add status open and closed game Aerofly FS 4 - Add speed knots text status - Add altitude text status
